FIDELITY DEPARTMENT Fidelity and Deposit Company OF MARYLAND SAN FRANCISCO BRANCH Financial Center Building Bond No. ____________________ February 8, 1929. ______, 19__ M Mr. R. C. Alers, Asst. Com. of Police Shanghai Municipal Police Shanghai, CHINA FED. OFF. AND FRAT. DIVISION______ BANK BOND DIVISION______________ GEN'L FIDELITY DIVISION_________ M Loo Chih Jen of Shanghai, China in the employ of ____________________ has applied to this Company to become surety upon his bond for $__________ as Clerk and has referred us to you for information concerning his character, business standing, etc. Will you be kind enough to answer the questions below, and to give on the reverse side hereof such additional information as you may be able to supply. The information you furnish us will make you in no way responsible, it being given solely for the benefit of this Company and of the Employer, and so enable us to judge the risk intelligently. If your knowledge of the applicant does not admit of your answering these questions, will you kindly let us have the names and addresses of parties who may be able to give us the desired information. Very truly yours, Chuck Miller President WILL you kindly let us have your reply at once. Delay may cause serious inconvenience or loss to applicant, as we may be unable to act on his application until we have the information which only you can give. QUESTIONS | ANSWERS ---|--- 1. Is this applicant related to you, and how? | 2. (a) Is applicant well known to you?
(b) How long have you known him?
(c) Have you recently been closely associated with him? If not, how long since? | (a)
(b)
(c) 3. Are applicant's parents or immediate family people of good standing and owners of property? | 4. Does applicant live beyond his means? If so, please state in what respect he is extravagant. | 5. Does applicant use intoxicants? To what extent? | 6. Does applicant speculate or gamble? If so, please give facts. | 7. Has applicant any income other than the salary he will receive from the position in which this bond is required? If so, please state amount, and source from which derived. | 8. By whom has applicant been employed during the last five years? Give dates, if possible, and address of each employer. | 9. Has applicant ever been dismissed from any position? If so, please state cause, and name and address of employer by whom dismissed. | 10. Has applicant ever been engaged in business on his own account? If so, when and where, and what was the nature of the business? | 11. Has applicant ever failed in business, or been bankrupt or insolvent? If so, kindly furnish full particulars and state whether he has since been released, and what settlement was made with creditors. | 12. (a) To the best of your knowledge, has the conduct of the applicant always been honest and upright?
(b) If applicant has ever been arrested, state on what charge, and the circumstances? | (a)
(b) 13. Do you consider applicant a person worthy of this Company's confidence, and one in whom you would place confidence, and can you recommend him for the above stated position? | Signature of Reference ____________________ Occupation ____________________ Dated ____________________ If your knowledge of the applicant is not sufficient to enable you to answer the above questions, will you kindly give us the names and addresses of parties who may be able to furnish such information. PLEASE RETURN THIS FORM TO THE COMPANY, SAN FRANCISCO BRANCH （右上角印章/批注：C. I. D. REGISTRY No. I. O. D. 97 ... 1-3-29） （右侧竖排文字：TATROG...）

C. 艾尔斯先生，助理总监 上海公共租界工部局警务处 中国，上海 联邦官员及兄弟会分部______ 银行保证分部______________ 一般忠诚分部_________ M 中国上海的罗志仁（音译） 受雇于 ____________________ 已向本公司申请为其担任职员一职、金额为 $__________ 的保证书提供担保，并请我们就其品行、商业信誉等向您查询。恳请您回答下列问题，并在背面提供您所能提供的任何其他信息。您所提供的信息不会使您承担任何责任，该信息仅供本公司及雇主受益，以便我们要明智地评估风险。若您对申请人的了解不足以回答这些问题，恳请您告知可能向我们提供所需信息的各方姓名及地址。 此致， 查克·米勒 总裁 恳请立即回复。延误可能会给申请人带来严重的不便或损失，因为在获得只有您才能提供的信息之前，我们无法处理其申请。 问题 | 答案 ---|--- 1. 申请人与您是否有亲属关系？如有，是何种关系？ | 2. IMPORTANT

This is an inquiry regarding an
applicant for bond through the

Fidelity and Deposit Company
OF MARYLAND
BALTIMORE

Kindly oblige us by answering
promptly and return in the
enclosed stamped envelope.

(This Company is engaged in the business of
writing Fidelity and Surety Bonds, Burglary and
Plate Glass Insurance. It aims to furnish the best
possible protection at the very lowest cost con-
sistent with that protection. Naturally, this cost
is measured in large part by the losses sustained.

(Should you ever have occasion to change the
opinion you are so kindly expressing on the other
side of this sheet, we should appreciate it if you
would advise us promptly to that effect, giving
us, if possible, your reasons for such changed
opinion. If everyone would do this it would en-
able this company and other surety companies to
reduce materially their losses and thereby reduce
correspondingly the cost of Fidelity Bonds.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
10 D. 97.
Foreign Section. Station,
REPORT
Date February 20, 1930.
Subject (in full)_ 14 Russian Emigrants.
Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by Tho Rubentam C.D.I.
With reference to the attached letter of February
11, 1930 from Mr. V. Grosse, Chairman of the Russian
Emigrants' Committee and Relief Association re: 14 Russian
Emigrants, inquiries show that there is nothing in Police
records concerning any of the persons named with the exception of the following:
Semibrotoff J.S. was charged at the French Mixed
Court for being drunk disorderly and resisting arrest on
August 28, 1925 and was sentenced to one week's imprisonment
and expelled for 1 year from French Concession.
V.L. Serreeff. (1) was charged at the French Mixed
Court for being drunk and disorderly on August 22, 1927,
and was sentenced to 5 days' imprisonment and fined $5.00.
(2) Charged at the Provisional Court on September 30, 1927
for being drunk and incapable and sentenced to 5 days'
imprisonment and a fine of $10.00. (3) Was charged at the
Provisional Court on January 19, 1928 for being drunk,
disorderly and assault on Police. Fined $20.00. (4) Was
charged at the Provisional Court on June 15, 1929 for being
drunk, disorderly and assault on Police. Fined $10.00.
(5) Was charged at the French Mixed Court on August 26, 1929
for being drunk, and found on enclosed premises. Fined
$3.00 or 3 days' imprisonment.
B. Maklaevsky.
D. S.
A/D. C. I.
Reg. Cellen as per draft
please.

外籍科。分局，

日期 1930年2月20日。
主题（全称）_ 14名俄国移民。
制作人 D.S. Maklaevsky。由 Tho Rubentam 刑事调查总监转发。
关于附件中1930年2月11日俄国移民委员会及救济协会主席 V. Grosse 先生有关14名俄国移民的来信，经查证，除以下人员外，警方记录中没有任何关于名单所列人员的记载：
Semibrotoff J.S. 于1925年8月28日在法公堂被控醉酒滋事及拒捕，被判监禁一周，并被驱逐出法租界一年。
V.L. Serreeff. (1) 于1927年8月22日在法公堂被控醉酒滋事，被判监禁5天并罚款5.00美元。(2) 于1927年9月30日在临时法院被控醉酒且无自理能力，被判监禁5天并罚款10.00美元。(3) 于1928年1月19日在临时法院被控醉酒、滋事及袭击警察。罚款20.00美元。(4) 于1929年6月15日在临时法院被控醉酒、滋事及袭击警察。罚款10.00美元。(5) 于1929年8月26日在法公堂被控醉酒，并在封闭场所内被发现。罚款3.00美元或监禁3天。
B. Maklaevsky.
D. S.

ОБЩЕСТВО „ПОМОЩЬ”
Russian Emigrants' Committee and Relief Association

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 917
Date. 13. - 2. - 30.

6A NANKING ROAD.
GROUND FLOOR, ROOMS 8, 12, 14 & 16.
TEL. 10108

Шанхай,
Shanghai, — 11th February 1930

Messrs. Criminal Investigation Department.
S.M. Police.

Dear Sirs,

14 Russian Emigrants applied to me with the request
to recommend them to the Shanghai Power Company for the employment.
My books contain the following information about them:

✓ VASSILIEFF, Nic. Nic. born on the 16th Feb. 1896, Orenburg. Naval
Officer arrived here 11 Dec. 1922. Resides at 90 Mac-
gregor rd.
DUBROVSKY, Alxdr. Efim., b. 19 June 1887, Poltava, came to Harbin
in 1912 being empl. by the Ch. E.R., came to Shanghai
in 1924, resides at 68/6 Route Vallon.
DUDEVSKY, Nic. Pl. b. 9 March 1895, Orel prov., bach. ar. 30 May
1929 from Mukden where he served in various firms for
10 mths. Served previously in the Ch. Army 2 y. 3 mths.
Electrician, resides at 110 Joffre Terrace.
KOSTIN, Fed. Sem. b. 5 July 1897, Orenburg prov., cossack, ar.
22 Sept. 1926, 699 Rue Ratard.
LATYSHEFF, Nic. Nic. b. 29 Apr. 1897, Irkutsk prov., bach. came
to China in 1920, lived in Harbin up to 1925, joined
the Ch. Army, discharged 17 May 1928, ar. 30 May 1928,
resides at 30 Ave Dubail.
PRZEDLIATSKY, Franz Stanisl. b. 17 May 1886, Warsaw, second class
Marine Engineer, s.s. Albatross. Married, resides at
155 East Seward rd.
✓ SEMIBRATOFF, Jac. Sem., b. 1903, 17 March, Primorsk Reg. bach. ar.
in 1923. Resides at 150 Broadway East.
✓ SERGEEFF, Vsev. Leon. b. 1895 16 June, Petrograd, subessaul
Ussuri Cossacks, Cossacks' Association, ar. in Sept.
1926 fr. Tsinanfoo where he served with Gen. Chekhoff
for 4 mths. Resided in Harbin 2 y. 8 mths., in the
empl. of the Ch. E.R. at Chalantun. Bach., sapper mil
engineer, gr. 1914. Resides at 505/20 Route Vallon.
SOLOKHA, Fed. Korn. b. 8 Feb. 1898 Amur Reg. Bach., trader, ar.
here fr. Tientsin 4 Jan. 1930. Res. Army & Navy Shelter,
51/53 r-te Pichon.

上海，
上海，— 1930年2月11日

致刑事调查处诸位先生。
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

敬启者：

14名俄国移民向我提出申请，请求推荐他们受雇于上海电力公司。
我的档案中存有他们的以下信息：

✓ VASSILIEFF, Nic. Nic. 生于1896年2月16日，奥伦堡。海军军官，1922年12月11日抵达此地。居住于麦格理高路90号。
DUBROVSKY, Alxdr. Efim., 生于1887年6月19日，波尔塔瓦，1912年来到哈尔滨，受雇于中东铁路，1924年来到上海，居住于华伦路68/6号。
DUDEVSKY, Nic. Pl. 生于1895年3月9日，奥廖尔省，单身，1929年5月30日从沈阳抵达，此前在沈阳各商行服务10个月。此前在中国军队服役2年3个月。电工，居住于茹弗台路110号。
KOSTIN, Fed. Sem. 生于1897年7月5日，奥伦堡省，哥萨克，1926年9月22日抵达，拉塔德路699号。
LATYSHEFF, Nic. Nic. 生于1897年4月29日，伊尔库茨克省，单身，1920年来华，在哈尔滨居住至1925年，加入中国军队，1928年5月17日退伍，1928年5月30日抵达，居住于杜拜尔路30号。
PRZEDLIATSKY, Franz Stanisl. 生于1886年5月17日，华沙，二等轮机工程师，“信天翁”号轮船。已婚，居住于东熙华德路155号。
✓ SEMIBRATOFF, Jac. Sem., 生于1903年3月17日，滨海边疆区，单身，1923年抵达。居住于百老汇路150号。
✓ SERGEEFF, Vsev. Leon. 生于1895年6月16日，彼得格勒，乌苏里哥萨克少尉，哥萨克协会成员，1926年9月从济南抵达，此前在 Chekhoff 将军麾下服役4个月。在哈尔滨居住2年8个月，在中东铁路查兰屯段任职。单身，工兵军事工程师，1914年毕业。居住于华伦路505/20号。
SOLOKHA, Fed. Korn. 生于1898年2月8日，阿穆尔州，单身，商人，1930年1月4日从天津抵达此地。居住于毕勋路51/53号海陆军收容所。

CHUDINOFF, Ivan Serge, b. 27/I 1892, Orenburg prov., married, came

SCHIRSKY-CHERNSKY, Ivan Jac. b. Sept. 1895, Kiev, ar. in Jan. 1928

SCHEKIN, Victor Alxis, b. 4 Nov. 1908, Tsitsikar, joined the Ch.

STEKLOFF, Const. Alxis. 生于1894年12月24日，喀山，已婚；1920年来到哈尔滨，1923-1927年加入中国军队，1927-1930年任中国警察情报科侦探，上校。居住于茹弗路153号。
CHUDINOFF, Ivan Serge, 生于1892年1月27日，奥伦堡省，已婚，1922年来华，在哈尔滨居住2年，在中国军队服役至1928年2月，1928年8月10日抵达。居住于拉塔德路599号。
SCHIRSKY-CHERNSKY, Ivan Jac. 生于1895年9月，基辅，1928年1月从哈尔滨抵达，此前在哈尔滨居住20年。中尉，司机。居住于罗伯特神父路22D号。
SCHEKIN, Victor Alxis, 生于1908年11月4日，齐齐哈尔，加入中国军队并进入济南军校。1929年12月12日抵达此地。居住于华德路12号。
YUSHKOFF, Afanssy Gabr., 生于1895年1月17日，叶尼塞省，单身，1923年抵达此地，居住于拉塔德路699号。

能否请告知我，作为机密信息，本部是否有关于他们的任何记录。

I. Gross.

I.O. D. 917
⑦
Strictly Confidential
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 917
Date 21 - 2 - 30
February 21, 30.

Dear Sir,
with reference to your letter of February 11,
1930, inquiring if there are any records in this
Department against fourteen Russians, who are applying
to the Shanghai Power Company for employment, I have
to state that the persons, whose names appear on the
list, are unknown to us, with the exception of
J.S. Semibratoff and V.L. Sergeeff. Semibratoff was
charged at the French Mixed Court for being drunk and
disorderly and resisting arrest on August 28, 1925
and was sentenced to one week's imprisonment and
expulsion from the French Concession for a year.
Sergeeff has been charged twice before the French
Mixed Court and three times before the Provisional
Court for being drunk and disorderly. Fines varying
from $3.00 to $20.00 were imposed on each occasion.
Yours faithfully,
Sgd: R. C. Harris.
N Director of Criminal Investigation.

Mr. V. Grosse,
Russian Emigrants' Committee and Relief Association,
6A Hongkong Road,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处

1930年2月21日。

敬启者：
关于您1930年2月11日的来信，询问本部是否有申请受雇于上海电力公司的十四名俄国人的记录，兹声明，除 J.S. Semibratoff 和 V.L. Sergeeff 外，名单上的人员我们均不了解。Semibratoff 于1925年8月28日在法公堂被控醉酒滋事及拒捕，被判监禁一周，并被驱逐出法租界一年。Sergeeff 曾在法公堂被起诉两次，在临时法院被起诉三次，罪名均为醉酒滋事。每次均处以3.00美元至20.00美元不等的罚款。
此致，
签名：R. C. Harris.
刑事调查总监。

致 V. Grosse 先生，
俄国移民委员会及救济协会，
香港路6A号，
上海。
